description: Armoured men in plate and mail wade out of wooden boats and rush toward a stone fortress with an arched wooden gate, torches burning on the walls. Two sailing ships with square and lateen sails sit in stormy grey water behind them, and a soldier climbs a ladder against the wall. Defenders in white head cloths throw things from the battlements. Painted in a dark oil style, no visible text, the image runs edge to edge.
